title: Honua component-version declaration v1
description: release/component-versions.json at the root of one component repository: the contract and schema versions that repository's source declares at that revision. The nightly resolver reads it at the selected sha; see docs/COMPONENT-VERSION-DECLARATIONS.md.

component.description: The platform-manifest component key this repository declares for.

schemaVersions.description: `database` is reserved: the resolver derives it from the selected honua-server migration tree.

versionMap.description: Name to exact version. An empty map is accepted here; the resolver permits it only for a component the platform manifest marks sourcePinnedOnly.
